Hello and welcome aboard <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

Early in the game, the fight are forgiving enough that you don't need a team with a great synergy so my advice is : pick 2 awakeners you like most, fill the blanks and enjoy the story.
By chapter 3, you should understand enough about the game's mechanics to improve the linup by yourself.

You will evebtually want 5 functionnal teams ( 19 awakeners ) so I suggest starting chapter 3 ( or before if you feel ready ) you try a bit of everything and give each awakener in your dorms a chance to shine.

You will get a lot more over time so maybe don't worry too m7ch about which team would ve perfect for you right now : it will evolve. You can upgrade everyone to lvl 40 without to much effort and lvl 60 if you commit a bit ( awakener level matters *a lot* in this game )

- Murphy:Fauxborn is awesome but quite hard to properly use
- Jenkins and Mouchette are heavy damage-dealer, rather easy to master
- Celeste is a great support which provided a free resurection in case things go wrong

Most impirtant of all : this *is* a game. So the right way to play just might be the funniest way to play <:Saya_duel:1513123467917135903>
If you didn't yet find Cheri's handbook, just type /new
I did try to make it clear do please do feel free to ask if you have further questions <:Saya_caught:1513123193341349968>
